AI Overview
Football Bros is a fast-paced, arcade-style American football browser game developed by Blue Wizard Digital. 
Game Overview
Developer: Blue Wizard Digital (creators of Soccer Bros, Basket Bros, and Shell Shockers).
Gameplay: Fast-paced action featuring quick matches, a full season Franchise Mode, college and pro teams, and online or local multiplayer.
Platforms: Playable in web browsers (Chrome recommended) as well as mobile devices via the App Store. 
Controls
Movement: Use WASD or the Arrow Keys to steer your player.
Action (Pass, Dive, Tackle, Stiff Arm): Press the Space Bar (or contextual keys in 2-player mode).
